Magic: The Gathering Comprehensive Rules

These rules are effective as of June 19, 2026.

Introduction

This document is the ultimate authority for Magic: The Gathering competitive game play.

1. Game Concepts

100. General

100.1. These Magic rules apply to any Magic game with two or more players.

100.1a A two-player game is a game that begins with only two players.

100.2. To play, each player needs their own deck of traditional Magic cards.

121. Drawing a Card

121.1. A player draws a card by putting the top card of their library into their hand.

2. Parts of a Card

205. Type Line

205.3. The card's subtypes, if any, appear to the right of the long dash.

205.3g Artifacts have their own unique set of subtypes. The artifact types are Attraction (see rule 717), Equipment (see rule 301.5), Fortification (see rule 301.6), and Vehicle (see rule 301.7).

205.3h Enchantments have their own unique set of subtypes. The enchantment types are Aura (see rule 303.4), Background, Case (see rule 719), Class (see rule 716), Role (see rule 303.7), Room, Saga (see rule 714), and Shrine.

205.3q Battles have their own unique set of subtypes. The battle types are Siege.

3. Card Types

301. Artifacts

301.5. Equipment is a subtype of artifact.

303. Enchantments

303.4. Auras are enchantments with the enchant keyword ability.

7. Additional Rules

701. Keyword Actions

701.1. Most actions described in a card's rules text use the standard English definitions.

701.16. Sacrifice

701.16a To sacrifice a permanent, its controller moves it from the battlefield to that player's graveyard.

702. Keyword Abilities

702.2. Deathtouch

702.2a Deathtouch is a static ability.

702.2b A creature with toughness greater than 0 that's been dealt damage by a source with deathtouch is destroyed.

702.14. Landwalk

702.14a Landwalk is a generic term for a group of abilities.

702.186. ∞ (Infinity)

702.186a ∞ (the mathematical symbol for infinity) is a keyword found on Infinity cards.

702.444. Testlink

702.444a A testlink ability. See rule 100.

714. Saga Cards

714.1. Each Saga card has a lore counter ability.

716. Class Cards

716.1. Each Class card has one or more level abilities.

717. Attraction Cards

717.1. Attraction cards are a subset of artifact cards used in the Unfinity set. See rule 100.

719. Case Cards

719.1. Each Case card has a suspect ability and a solve ability.

Glossary

Ability Word
An italicized word with no rules meaning that ties together abilities on different cards that have similar functionality. See rule 207.2c.

Forestwalk
See Landwalk.

Long Dash
The symbol that separates a permanent's card types from its subtypes on the type line. See rule 205.3g.

Megamorph
A keyword ability. See rule 702.37, "Morph."

Sacrifice
To move a permanent from the battlefield to its owner's graveyard. See rule 701.16, "Sacrifice."
